$comment: v1 scaffolding for the local-model-benchmarking module — the constellation's apps (Fonebrew, Studio, the future asystemofmodels router) consume this to pick models per device. Grammar mirrors Android-IDE-core's schemas/integrations/* house style: schemaVersion pinned to major 1, a producer{app,version} block, and an unknownFields passthrough bag for forward-compat round-tripping. Not wrapped in a ContractEnvelope — :modelbench is a standalone JVM module with zero dependency on core's envelope library, same posture as that repo's assay-index.v1 (a fully independent producer's own file). Numeric metrics are 'number' (not 'integer') because tok/s and ms values are computed, not counted.
title: ModelBenchReport
description: One benchmark session's result: a device+engine+model triple run through a context-length sweep, each point producing timing/throughput/memory metrics. Written by ModelBenchReport.toJson() (dev.aarso.modelbench.json, JVM module :modelbench) after BenchmarkSuite.run() completes a full sweep.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this report shape. A reader MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major is not '1'.

reportId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this benchmark session, independent of device/model identity.

generatedAt.description: UTC instant the sweep completed and this report was assembled.

runs.description: One entry per context-length sweep point, in the order the sweep was run.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip.

version.description: The producing app/module's own release version.

deviceModel.description: Build.MODEL or equivalent identifying string. Owner-verified on-device only; a JVM-host run should supply a synthetic/placeholder value rather than leave it blank.

thermalStatus.description: PowerManager thermal status label at report time, if readable.

governor.description: CPU scaling governor, if readable (root/sysfs-dependent; frequently null).

name.description: EngineAdapter.engineName — e.g. 'llama.cpp' once the real adapter lands, 'synthetic' for scripted test runs.

paramsB.description: Parameter count in billions, if known.

contextLength.description: The context-length sweep point this run targeted.

thermal.description: Sampled once per run via the ThermalSampler hook. Null when no sampler was supplied (the default on a JVM-only run) or the platform couldn't answer.

timeToFirstTokenMs.description: Elapsed time from the start of generateTokens() to its first token callback. Null when a run generated zero tokens.

promptProcessingTokPerSec.description: tokensProcessed / prompt-processing elapsed seconds. Zero (never NaN/Infinity) when elapsed time is zero.

decodeTokPerSec.description: tokensGenerated / decode elapsed seconds. Zero (never NaN/Infinity) when elapsed time is zero.

peakRssDeltaBytes.description: Peak resident-set size sampled after this run minus the value sampled right after loadModel(). Null when the adapter can't report RSS on both samples (true for SyntheticEngine and any JVM-host run).

loadTimeMs.description: loadModel() wall time. Load happens once per sweep, not per point, so this repeats identically across every run in a report's runs[].

status.description: Platform thermal status label at sample time (e.g. Android's THERMAL_STATUS_* names). Vocabulary is intentionally open-ended — real sensors are a device-side hook this schema does not constrain.

atElapsedNanos.description: Nanos since the sampled run began, if the sampler timestamped it.
